title: Phone-er battery bachanor 5 ta tip 🔋
points: Screen brightness auto rakho, beshi bright korle charge druto shesh hoy.
Jei app gulo use koro na, background data bondho koro.
Dark mode on korle AMOLED screen-e battery bache.
Phone 20 theke 80 percent-er moddhe charge rakhle battery besi din bhalo thake.
Battery saver mode dorkar-e on koro.

title: Phone dhimey hole ki korbe? 🐢
points: Storage 90 percent-er beshi bhorle phone slow hoy, faltu file muche felo.
Kono app-er cache clear koro, Settings theke.
Phone-e ekbar restart dao, shokto upokar pay.
Je app gulo lagbe na, uninstall koro.
Software update thik shomoy-e koro.

title: WiFi speed barano-r 5 ta upay 📶
points: Router ta ghore majhkhane, uchu jayga-y rakho.
Router-e ekbar restart dao, speed thik hoy.
Beshi manush connect thakle speed kome, ar device bad dao.
5GHz band thakle seta use koro, speed beshi paba.
WiFi password shobar kache dio na, onno keu use korle speed kome.

title: Online-e nijer account surokkhito rakho 🔒
points: Prottek account-e alada password dao.
2-step verification on koro, Facebook, Gmail shob-e.
Onojana link-e click korar age bhabo, phishing hote pare.
Public WiFi-te bank ba password-er kaj koro na.
Password-e naam ba jonmodin diyo na.

title: Kichu moja-r tech fact 🤯
points: Prothom computer mouse kath diye toiri hoyechilo.
Prothom email 1971 shale pathano hoyechilo.
Internet-er shurute-r nam chilo ARPANET.
QWERTY keyboard-er layout typewriter-er jam komanor jonno toiri.

title: Phone-er camera valo korar 5 tip 📸
points: Lens ta ekta noram kapor diye muche nao.
Alo-r dike mukh rekhe chobi tolo, natural alo shobcheye bhalo.
Grid line on koro, chobi shoja hoy.
Zoom na kore nijer ektu kache giye chobi tolo.
Chobi tolar age focus kore nao, screen-e tap kore.
